DEVI's GOODBYE

By: Nicky Troll | Production

Proposal


Show: Carte Blanche

One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...):
We bid farewell to Carte Blanche Anchor Devi Sankaree Govender

Further information:
A story looking at the highlights of Devi's time with Carte Blanche - 18 years, 800 stories later we look at some of the Golden Moments - the hair raising snippets to classic CB moments that had us all laughing.

Script:


STRUCTURE

VO: 13 SECONDS
At just 1.5 meters tall and weighing in at 52kg. Devi Sankaree Govender may be tiny, but….. she is feisty, she is fearless and if you’ve been even the slightest bit dodgy - she is frightening.

DIVORCE CON
GWEN: No, no, no
DEVI: Yes, yes – today is your day.

VO: 18 SECONDS
As we look back at Devi’s epic career at Carte Blanche – it’s been quite a ride from rubbing shoulders with celebrities, to catching crooks and reporting from the frontlines.

Her relentless determination to expose corruption and injustice was evident from the very first crook she chased down in 2002. [story name on screen]

DRIVERS
DEVI: We need to talk to you…//
DEVI: Is there corruption here?
LANCE: There is no corruptions here. I hope that fucking camera is off.

VO: 10 SECONDS
With a proper Carte Blanche scuffle on her first big bust – the tone was set.

18 years and over 800 stories later – Devi, has never looked back.

UPSOUND: It’s your right to a reply you have the opportunity to do that…

VO: 4 SECONDS
From surprising people peddling stolen goods out of the boot of their cars….

STOLEN BATTERIES
DEVI: You are in possession of this is stolen
MOSES: is it? (looks to the side)

VO: 3 SECONDS
To catching a Stripper Scamster with his pants literally down.

STRIPPER
DEVI: “I’m just gonna run behind you… your pants are falling down, pull them up.”

VO: 2 SECONDS
She’s not one to back down…

NOT SO CANDID CAMERA
SCUFFLE
DEVI: I’m warning… you my friend.

VO: 5.5 SECONDS
You’d think if you got away with raking in millions of rands in what appeared to be an unholy alliance….

UPSOUND: Sold at R 55 MILLION Rand!

VO: 3 SECONDS
You’d be smart enough not to lie to Devi….

AUCTION ALLIANCE 2012
UPSOUND UNHOLY ALLIANCE 2
Devi: 'It's Devi, Carte Blanche.' [On intercom]
Man 2: 'From where?'
Devi: 'Is that Rael Levitt?' [On intercom]
Man 2: 'Yes.'
Devi: 'It's Devi from Carte Blanche.'
[On intercom] Man: Let me check if he’s gone out…
VO: Suddenly the voice changed….

VO: 11 SECONDS
But there’s more to Devi than just chasing crooks, she’s interviewed international celebrities, local icons, presidents and was even caught gushing with one of her idols, Lionel Richie.

UPSOUND: 2008 LIONEL: My endless LOVe

VO: 4.5 SECONDS
If Devi is anything, she is authentic even when she’s on the chase…

OLD GAS STORY
DEVI: Hello luvie – how you? Joh! You can smell the gas - are you ok? Where’s your boss?
UPSOUND – CAR SPEEDING PAST

VO: 11 SECONDS
She got the inside track from illegal street racers, got uncomfortably upclose with nudists, and sat down for an inkless tattoo to give viewers on honest opinion on the experience…

TATTOO
DEVI – D for daredevil let me tell you…

VO: 5 SECONDS
She’s been at the frontlines covering the moments that have impacted the country.

TOWNSHIP OF TERROR
DEVI: It’s twenty past 9……yada yada…. Weapons and sticks

VO: 15 SECONDS
With a brave heart and an inherent need for justice running through her veins… Devi has chased hijackers, ventured into Drug dens, exposed backstreet abortion clinics (KNOCKING SOUND) and sat opposite house robbers asking tough questions.

SHOOT TO KILL
DEVI: did you shoot anybody?
ROBBER: don’t know if they are dead or alive.

VO: 6 SECONDS
Devi’s ability to make sense of complicated investigative stories has landed many a rogue in the hotseat.

JRA
DEVI: It’s best to disclose now, at the beginning, because you know I’ve got more…
UPSOUND: where’s Wele – It’s the police….

VO: 19 SECONDS
With Devi’s unwavering approach to journalism, you were guaranteed that weak excuses would not be accepted and difficult questions would not go unanswered on her watch.

Dr Anwar Jeewa, the owner of a Durban Rehab centre had a patient die on the premises under questionable cricumstances – he did not get off lightly.

IBOGAINE
D – He came here….– addict
A – correct
A – yah so – what is wrong
D – I tell you what is wrong he is dead

VO: 7 SECONDS
One thing we can agree on is that not everyone was always happy to see Devi marching towards them with camera crew in tow.

GAS 2019
DEVI: Devi carte blanche – shake my hand not so bad – but you know you’ve got a problem.
RUBBLE
DRIVER: Druk daai ding in jou gat.
PUPPY MILL
JAN: Now shut up about it…I know it’s not right, I’m getting irriatate
DEVI: don’t tell me to shut up.

VO: 8 SECONDS
But Dynamite Devi is not one to be intimidated, standing her ground in unnerving situations never flinching (VISUAL ELECTRICIAN // STOCK THEFT)

BOOB BEAST
DEVI: yah, but Don’t touch me

VO: 6 SECONDS
But one story Devi will not forget is the day threats turned to violence with Durban’s Gumtree Gang.

GUMTREE GANG
GG turned on the CB crew – left the crew bleeding… intent to do grevious bodily harm

VO: 16 SECONDS
From thugs to small time scamsters to big shots, Devi’s never shied away from turning up the heat in interviews. Eskom’s then Group Executive of Generation, Mashelo Koko was almost rendered speechless when she caught him in a lie about the infamous Gupta prepayment.

OPTIMUM
DEVI: Mr Koko I’m not moving on from this as quickly as you would like me to…
KOKO: Lets say I made a mistake
DEVI: you made a mistake
KOKO: …Let’s do that…

VO: 14 SECONDS
The inadequacies of government departments have been under the Carte Blanche spotlight often, from the Esidimeni Tradegy to the Oncology crisis in KZN – Devi has put a number MECs on the spot, speaking up for the vulnerable.

KZN ONCOLOGY
MEC The point of
DEVI: are you passing the buck MEC
MEC: I don’t think machines,
DEVI: But you
MEC: me and you will have a different view point on this matter.

VO: 9.5 SECONDS
But even when culprits were sometimes disillusioned about their own skills or rather lack there of – Devi wouldn’t skip a beat when it came to setting the record straight.

CODEINE:
DEVI: Are you listening to yourselves
AUNTY: Listening to myself
DEVI: feeds codeine addiction, is she breaking law… right or wrong? Correct me if I’m wrong

VO: 5.5 SECONDS
Over the years Devi’s developed a kind of supernatural ability to separate fact from fiction.

UPSOUND TOILET FLUSHING

VO: 9.5 SECONDS
Like in the case of Benoni’s Doctor Drive-Thru, where you can get anything from sick notes to scheduled medication without scripts - all for a fee.

DODGY DOCTOR
DA – this person convinced me she wasn’t well
D – she convinced you with R300

VO: 7 SECONDS
Devi had the country rooting for the baddie this one time, when she set this dodgy pool builder a cheeky challenge.

POOL CON
DEVI: You’re kidding me here right, If you finish I’ll skinny dip in each one….
GUS: LAUGHS SHEEPISHLY

VO: 3.5 SECONDS
On the rare occasion, some people would just own up and confess…

TURNING BACK THE CLOCKS
LOUIS: I’m guilty
TRANSPORT CON
ELSIE: YahI’m guilty
DEVI
ELSIE
DEVI: That’s fraud!

VO: 9 SECONDS
Looking back at Devi Sankaree Govender’s golden moments – she is the Queen of Confronts, and it’s been nothing short of a privilege having her on the Carte Blanche team.

 
PROMO 1
VO: As we bid farewell to Devi Sankaree Govender, we take a look at some of her golden moments on Carte Blanche as she rubbed shoulders with celebrities, chased crooks and grilled big shots.

PROMO 2
VO: We look back at Devi Sankaree Govender’s epic career at Carte Blanche – it’s been quite a ride from rubbing shoulders with celebrities, to catching crooks and reporting from the frontlines.

PROMO 3
VO: We revisit some of the most memorable stories Devi Sankaree Govender covered [over the last 18 years] as she bids the show farewell, from chasing crooks to getting upclose with nudists and spending time with celebrities.
(can cut 18 years if too long)
